columns.note: per-column totals are NOT preserved by design: each parent keeps its child COUNT but receives different children

fallback_rule: an unseen FULL type is never mapped to any FULL column; its COARSE parent still counts

parent_shuffle.definition: permute the selected FULL types' parent labels within family, numpy default_rng(seed=0)

support_weight_reparameterisation.definition: x'_f = F_f / sqrt(a_f) so that plain L2 on w equals sum_f a_f v_f^2
support_weight_reparameterisation.identity: v_f = w_f / sqrt(a_f); z = sum_f F_f v_f = sum_f (F_f/sqrt(a_f)) w_f
